definitions.gloss: gesture; body language; physical movement to convey meaning
definitions.explanation: Movements of the body, especially the hands and arms, used to express or emphasize something. Often paired with 手振り in the set phrase 身振り手振り.

examples.japanese: {身振|みぶ}り{手振|てぶ}りを{交|まじ}えて{説明|せつめい}した。
examples.english: I explained using gestures and hand movements.

examples.japanese: {言葉|ことば}が{通|つう}じなかったので、{身振|みぶ}り{手振|てぶ}りで{道|みち}を{教|おし}えてもらった。
examples.english: Since we didn't share a language, they gave me directions using gestures.

notes:
Very commonly used in the compound phrase {身振|みぶ}り{手振|てぶ}り, which emphasizes the use of the whole body and hands together to communicate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {身振|みぶ}り{手振|てぶ}り (gestures and hand movements)
- {身振|みぶ}りで{伝|つた}える (to communicate through gestures)
- {身振|みぶ}りを{交|まじ}える (to use gestures along with speech)
- {大|おお}きな{身振|みぶ}り (exaggerated gestures)

USAGE NOTE:
While {身振|みぶ}り can be used alone, the paired form {身振|みぶ}り{手振|てぶ}り is far more common in everyday speech. The compound ジェスチャー is also used, especially in casual contexts.
